generator.program.note: The lineage's own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the herb base: it gives the values its species leave unset, which the herb program gave as defaults until then.

traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz's description of the trillium group (Trilliaceae) (the DELTA distribution's own page for it, read 2026-10-15): flowers 3-5(-8)-merous; gynoecium 3-6(-10)-carpelled, as many as the perianth parts, superior. Stated 3, the low end of that range and Trillium's number.

traits.perianth.note: Hutchinson (vol. 2, 2nd ed., 1959), families 372 Liliaceae (its false hellebores, death camases and bear grass) and 374 Trilliaceae (Trillium and Paris), which APG joins as Melanthiaceae: perianth of six parts in two whorls, alike in most, the outer green and sepal-like and the inner petal-like in Trillium and Paris; stamens as many as the perianth's parts, usually 6; ovary superior, of 3 carpels; fruit a capsule, or a berry in Paris and many trilliums.

traits.flower_symmetry.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data), family Melanthiaceae with Trilliaceae: flowers regular or irregular as coded, a state the authors qualify keeping its word (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py).

traits.zygomorphy.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data), family Melanthiaceae with Trilliaceae: its irregular flowers are of no named kind (pea flower, two lips, orchid lip), read from the coded corolla symmetry (spec-rework/b1/delta): zygomorphy other. Its flowers are not mostly zygomorphic, so a plant of it states its own symmetry; one that is zygomorphic draws this kind, and one stating none is drawn regular.

traits.leaf_division.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data), family Melanthiaceae with Trilliaceae, which APG and WCVP join to it (their extra states read as sometimes): leaves simple; the simple blade none. Read from the coded leaf form and dissection by script (spec-rework/b1/delta).

traits.perennation.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Melanthiaceae, with the parts of Melanthiaceae it codes as families of their own (Trilliaceae), whose further states read as sometimes: how its perennial herbs last from year to year (character 25), coded usually a rhizome, sometimes tubers, rarely a corm; with them, usually a rhizome, sometimes tubers, rarely a corm. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py with character 25 added); states the authors do not qualify, side by side, read as often.
